text: Average order value went up by 12000 BRL between 2018-02 and 2018-03. The largest contribution came from SC (7200 BRL). The second largest contribution came from ES (4800 BRL). Average order value is defined as: Revenue divided by delivered orders The figure comes from raw.orders, raw.order_payments; the logged cleaning steps are parse_dates, drop_exact_duplicates.
